summary: {official} traces the route a wheelchair user would take from an auditorium seat to the stage.
realLife: At O'Banion Auditorium, inspectors found no accessible path between the wheelchair seating and the stage.
gates: A public event uses a stage in an auditorium with a documented gap in the route from seating.
inGame: needs: the event layout, wheelchair seating location and route to the platform.

turns.what: They set up the microphone on the audience floor.
turns.pulledBy: Organizers can move the speakers to floor level.
turns.writesBack: The event plan records the new speaking location.

turns.what: Facilities staff check how it connects to the seating area.
turns.pulledBy: A permanent stage route is proposed.
turns.writesBack: The capital request includes both ends of the route.
